annotations.text:
Clubhouse scorecard, hi-fi.

Ink #1b2019 on cream #f2eee1, one accent green #1f5a2c used only as a solid fill behind cream text — that is the fix for the direction's sun-legibility weakness: nothing important is green-on-cream.

Instrument Serif for names and numbers, Space Grotesk for everything else. Ruled grid: 1.5px outer rules, 1px inner dividers, 4–6px radii, pills for chips and toggles.
The live round is the screen that matters. Whole hole visible at once: games as rows, players as columns, tap a cell to set rank. Cells are 40px inside 62px rows — the row is the real target.
Admin is the only desktop screen — it is central config you do at home, not on the tee. Points-by-rank is edited as a row of rank boxes, so adding a 4th place is one tap.
